topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the students and outlines the purpose and scope of the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses microbial presence and tissue damage using molecular patterns, receptor families, and downstream signaling complexes.

topics.label: Cellular Activation, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the cellular events triggered by sentinel cell activation, from endothelial signaling and leukocyte extravasation to lymphatic migration and systemic complications.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that turn off acute inflammation, promote tissue healing, and manage persistent infection or injury through chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and introduces the topic of the upcoming lecture.
